2105-5144-8296-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-5144-8296-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-5144-8296-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Ephemerate from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Ephemerate from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

2486-4247-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites:
You control your commander.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2486-4247-4694-7306.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Chef.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1170-3698-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
392-1170-3698-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {1}.
Birgi and Displacer Kitten trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell. When the artifact enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact, causing a player to mill three cards
Repeat.

5702-7798-7824.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
5702-7798-7824.description:
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the Forest that enters untapped.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 3.

2232-7827-7833-7837.easyPrerequisites: One of the Dwarves with mana value 1 must be on your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
2232-7827-7833-7837.description:
Cast the Dwarf with mana value 1 that's in your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the Dwarf enters, Cloudstone Curio and Thorin trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Dwarf with mana value 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R/W}.
Repeat.

4399-4716-4770-5998.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Prosperous Innkeeper trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Prosperous Innkeeper trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4716-4770-5998.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

129-206-1409-3755.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5231-5542-6149.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5231-5542-6149.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Stirring Bard from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Stirring Bard enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Stirring Bard.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Stirring Bard that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Stirring Bard token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Stirring Bard token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Stirring Bard that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Stirring Bard trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5231-5542-6149.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

851-1563-3899-4478.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

2556-4050-7364.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Mnemonic Wall and another nontoken creature, adding {1}{W}.
Cast Continue? by paying {1}{W}, returning Mnemonic Wall and at least one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mnemonic Wall enters, it triggers, returning Continue? from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
2556-4050-7364.notes: You can sacrifice up to two additional creatures each loop to net mana.

3094-4659-5390-7292-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
3094-4659-5390-7292-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {2} due to Forensic Gadgeteer and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield as a 3/3 Robot artifact creature.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

486-1978-7308.description:
Cause Mona Lisa to become an artifact using Liquimetal Torque.
Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Mona Lisa.
Repeat from step 2.

2511-5170-6132-6794.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

3678-5256-7084.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

933-6913-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
933-6913-7009.description:
Activate Chameleon using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Chameleon. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

5220-6538-6797-6900.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Fear of Lost Teeth.
When Fear of Lost Teeth dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fear of Lost Teeth from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Fear of Lost Teeth trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to any target
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Cast Fear of Lost Teeth from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

431-1270-1308-4365.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-1270-1308-4365.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of twelve 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

1329-1482-3338.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Jeweled Lotus.
Cast Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1306-1690-2538-4985.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand that can be cast for {0} due to Jhoira's Familiar.
1306-1690-2538-4985.description:
Activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast an artifact by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Mana Crypt to your hand.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Mana Crypt by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the artifact cast in step 3 to your hand.
Repeat.
1306-1690-2538-4985.notes: You can use a historic creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

186-2060-3062-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
186-2060-3062-5140.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

2713-4499-5420.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Plundering Pirate.
When Plundering Pirate enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1754-2438-4766-5683.notablePrerequisites:
All permanents on the battlefield.
Deathrender attached to Guan Yu.
1754-2438-4766-5683.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Guan Yu.
When Guan Yu dies, it, Deathrender and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Guan Yu trigger, causing you to shuffle it into your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, causing you to search your library for Guan Yu and put it into your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Guan Yu from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2397-3334-3484-5391.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
2397-3334-3484-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a tapped 3/3 Robot artifact creature token.
When the Robot enters the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

147-2528-4499.description:
Cast Channel the Suns by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Channel the Suns.
Resolve the copy of Channel the Suns, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

2523-3008-4891.description:
Cast Blade of Shared Souls by paying {2}{U}.
When Blade of Shared Souls enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token, then attaching Blade of Shared Souls to it, and causing the Rebel creature token to become a copy of Atsushi.
Put the token Atsushi into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the token dies, it and Ratadrabik trigger.
Resolve the token trigger, creating three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Ratadrabik trigger, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Atsushi that is a 2/2 Zombie.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Activate Blade of Shared Souls' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to the Atsushi token and causing it to become a copy of Atsushi.
Repeat from step 3.

147-4493.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication
147-4493.description:
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Irenicus's Vile Duplication, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Irenicus's Vile Duplication, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.

2021-2060-3062-3129.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.
